Answer: C
Reason: Comparing the 2003 and 2007 chest X-rays, there is a noticeable progression of fibrotic changes and increased pleural thickening/apical scarring in the upper lobes. In patients with advanced sarcoidosis and cavitary or fibrotic lung disease, this structural distortion creates a niche for Aspergillus colonization, leading to an aspergillus mycetoma (fungus ball), which is a known complication fitting the description of worsening apical/pleural pathology.
